headline: One picture, 2253 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 4 different files and attached to 2253 different works in 10 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 2253 separate works.

The 4 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 1 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.003 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): abb49c3beca7 on 725 works, b2e71b22ef25 on 685 works, d21ef19ac7a2 on 662 works, 4b9ea1bd9e30 on 181 works.
The works are recorded as: Recharge Pit (2240), Other (11), Soak Pit (2).
The entries were made by 3 different offices: Clerk, Senior Assistant, Sub Divisional Officer.
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Makhu, Zira.
